_about: Engineer-reviewed support decisions. reviewedLines preserve literal rules wording and name implemented primitives. Each reviewed entry records the exact evidence base SHA and hashes of the full Oracle rules record and adopted runtime/SDK JARs. A rules or runtime change invalidates the decision; unrelated card commits do not. Source review authorizes candidate implementation only, never certification or integration.

Eldrazi Displacer.summary: exile-then-return is Effects.Move(→EXILE) then Effects.Move(→BATTLEFIELD) (upstream Emiel the Blessed); Effects.Move takes a tapped flag (sdk-api.md, card-sdk-language-reference 'tapped = true'); {C} in an activation cost is ordinary mana

Forsaken Monument.summary: AdditionalManaOnSourceTap(sourceFilter, whenProducing = TappedForManaType.COLORLESS) takes any GameObjectFilter, so Permanent.youControl() replaces Ultima's Land.youControl(); colorless filter is GameObjectFilter.Any.withCardPredicate(CardPredicate.IsColorless) (tested custom Skittering Cicada)

Abstruse Archaic.summary: TargetFilter.ActivatedOrTriggeredAbilityOnStack.youControl().abilitySourceMatches(filter) takes any GameObjectFilter (Echo uses Creature; reference lists Artifact too); colorless via CardPredicate.IsColorless; mana abilities are untargetable by construction

Darksteel Monolith.summary: MayCastWithoutPayingManaCost(controllerOnly, spellFilter, oncePerTurn, fromZones) — Warped Space uses oncePerTurn + fromZones={EXILE}; here spellFilter = colorless (CardPredicate.IsColorless), fromZones = {HAND}. Paying {0} rather than the mana cost is the same alternative cost

Acolyte Hybrid.summary: Heavy Rock Cutter is an ability word. Attack trigger with up to one target artifact = Kellan, Inquisitive Prodigy. 'If an artifact is destroyed this way, its controller draws' = the pinned destroy-outcome pipeline: gather(ChosenTargets) -> moveTracked(MoveType.Destroy) (indestructible/regenerated/removed targets drop out) -> ifNotEmpty(destroyed) -> ForEachPlayer(Player.ControllerOf(target)) draw 1, exactly as Dire Strain Rampage ('its controller') and Break the Spell ('destroyed this way, draw'). The #141 Priority A blocker (unverified) is disproven; the 'outcome of a specific destroy' pattern blocker is removed.

Tangleweave Armor.summary: Dynamic equipped-creature stats use GrantDynamicStats and Filters.EquippedCreature (Cranial Plating scenario-tested). Aggregate each commander-filtered zone's greatest mana value with DynamicAmounts.battlefield/zone(...).maxManaValue(), then combine zone values with DynamicAmounts.max; Zone.COMMAND, commander filtering, and zone aggregations are supported by the committed SDK API. Emissary Escort, Boon of Boseiju, and Wick's Patrol implement the constituent dynamic-stat and max-mana-value patterns; Akroma's Will scenario-tests commander filtering.
